title: Veltrix Dynamics
text: Veltrix Dynamics is an industrial drone manufacturer founded in 1998 by Mira Osterfeld. Headquarters: Harlow Pike. 2023 revenue: 412 million USD. Employees (2023): 2,150. Best-known product: the Kestrel-9 survey drone.

title: Veltrix Robotics
text: Veltrix Robotics is a warehouse-automation startup, not affiliated with Veltrix Dynamics. Founded in 2012 in Lindell Bay by Joren Vasquez. Employees (2023): 85.

title: Quorra Biotech
text: Quorra Biotech is a biotechnology company founded in 2006. Headquarters: Lindell Bay. CEO: Tomas Arvane (since 2015). 2023 revenue: 187 million USD. Employees (2023): 940.

title: Nimbic Foods
text: Nimbic Foods is a packaged-food producer founded in 1985. Headquarters: Carrow Falls. CEO: Priya Lanford (since 2011). 2023 revenue: 1.26 billion USD. Employees (2023): 8,400.

title: Harlow Pike
text: Harlow Pike is a town in Estmark province. Population (2020 census): 48,300. Elevation: 312 m.

title: Lindell Bay
text: Lindell Bay is a coastal city and the capital of Varnholt province. Population (2020 census): 126,500. Elevation: 8 m.

title: Carrow Falls
text: Carrow Falls is a mountain town in Estmark province. Population (2020 census): 23,900. Elevation: 540 m.

title: Tessaly
text: Tessaly is the capital city of Estmark province. Population (2020 census): 310,000. Elevation: 95 m.

title: Estmark province
text: Estmark is a province covering 18,400 km2 with a population of 2,100,000. Capital: Tessaly. Currency: the Estmark crown (EKR).

title: Varnholt province
text: Varnholt is a province covering 9,750 km2 with a population of 1,350,000. Capital: Lindell Bay.

title: Estmark crown (EKR) exchange rate
text: The Estmark crown (EKR) is the currency of Estmark province. Fixed exchange rate: 1 EKR = 0.62 USD.

title: Mira Osterfeld
text: Mira Osterfeld (born 1961 in Carrow Falls) is an engineer and the founder of Veltrix Dynamics.

title: Tomas Arvane
text: Tomas Arvane (born 1974 in Harlow Pike) is a biochemist who has been CEO of Quorra Biotech since 2015.

title: Priya Lanford
text: Priya Lanford (born 1969 in Tessaly) has been CEO of Nimbic Foods since 2011.

title: Joren Vasquez
text: Joren Vasquez (born 1988 in Lindell Bay) is the founder of Veltrix Robotics.

title: Brightwater Rail
text: Brightwater Rail is a passenger rail line connecting Harlow Pike and Lindell Bay. Length: 214 km. Average train speed: 89 km/h.

title: Kestrel-9 drone
text: The Kestrel-9 is a survey drone made by Veltrix Dynamics, launched in 2017. List price: 5,500 Estmark crowns (EKR).

title: Orin Cup
text: The Orin Cup is an annual regional ice hockey trophy. Winners: 2018 Harlow Pike Owls; 2019 Lindell Bay Herons; 2020 Carrow Falls Stags; 2021 Lindell Bay Herons; 2022 Carrow Falls Stags; 2023 Lindell Bay Herons.
